g.title: crate Server of the Kivact DevTools inside a target app.
crate::agent The agent a target app runs: start, incoming calls, notifications and its files.
crate::config The workspace root and the `.kivact/devtools.json` configuration.
crate::connection One connection: its handshake, forwarded calls and cleanup.
crate::discovery The discovery file of this agent: writing it and removing it.
crate::files Atomic file writes and the default path of a trace file.
crate::image PNG and base64 bytes for screenshots.
crate::image::tests Tests of the base64 alphabet and the PNG signature.
crate::incoming What the agent hands the core: calls to answer and connection endings.
crate::launcher Start the DevTools app for a target.
crate::launcher::tests Tests of the order in which the DevTools app is looked for.
crate::review_store The review of one session: items, comments, images and saved files.
crate::review_store::tests Tests of the review ids, the saved files and the screenshot path.
crate::server The listener thread: accepts connections and starts a reader thread for each.
crate::session Who is connected, what they follow, and what every connection thread reads.
crate::source Read a source line to find the name a signal was bound to.
crate::source::tests Tests of the identifier found after `let` on a source line.
